    BO13a Lemma 8: set-up #

    • MulBasis.no_crown4: a minimal crown of length at least six excludes crowns of length four.
    • MulBasis.no_fig21: BO13a figure 2.1 — two morphisms γ, δ into m incomparable from the right and two morphisms α, β out of m incomparable from the left, with nonzero composites, give the crown (γ ≫ α, δ ≫ α, δ ≫ β, γ ≫ β) of length four.
